title: No universal SOTA in spatial-domain detection: spatial priors help iff the ground truth is spatially contiguous (Tessera-ST benchmark code and manuscript)
description:
Analysis code, synthetic-tissue generator, machine-checked verification harness, figures, and manuscript for the Tessera-ST spatial-domain benchmark. The study benchmarks seven spatial-domain detection methods across 11 platforms and shows there is no universal state-of-the-art; instead, the value of spatial priors is predictable from the ground truth's spatial contiguity (Spearman +0.72), a relationship that is confound-independent, predictive out-of-sample, causal under a controlled manipulation, and deployable label-free. Every reported number is regenerated by scripts in experiments/ and machine-checked by verify_manuscript.py.
